require 'socket'
require 'thread'
require 'tempfile'
require 'fileutils'
require 'securerandom'

module ProxyUpload
  class ConnectionPool
    def initialize(max_size: 10)
      @pool = []
      @max_size = max_size
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @generation = 0
    end

    def checkout
      @mutex.synchronize do
        conn = @pool.shift || create_connection
        conn[:checked_out] = true
        conn[:generation] = @generation
        conn
      end
    end

    def checkin(conn)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        conn[:checked_out] = false
        if conn[:generation] == @generation && @pool.size < @max_size
          @pool.push(conn)
        else
          conn[:socket]&.close rescue nil
          conn[:buffer] = nil
        end
      end
    end

    def drain!
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @generation += 1
        @pool.each { |c| c[:socket]&.close rescue nil; c[:buffer] = nil }
        @pool.clear
      end
    end

    private

    def create_connection
      { socket: nil, buffer: String.new(capacity: 65536), checked_out: false, generation: @generation }
    end
  end

  class UploadHandler
    CHUNK_SIZE = 8192
    MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024

    def initialize(pool, backend_host, backend_port)
      @pool = pool
      @backend_host = backend_host
      @backend_port = backend_port
      @pending_callbacks = {}
      @callback_mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def handle_upload(client_socket, content_length, request_id)
      return error_response(client_socket, 413) if content_length > MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE

      conn = @pool.checkout
      temp = Tempfile.new(['upload', '.bin'])
      bytes_read = 0

      callback_ref = register_callback(request_id, conn, temp)

      reader_thread = Thread.new do
        begin
          while bytes_read < content_length
            chunk = client_socket.readpartial([CHUNK_SIZE, content_length - bytes_read].min)
            break if chunk.nil? || chunk.empty?
            temp.write(chunk)
            bytes_read += chunk.bytesize
            conn[:buffer] << chunk
            if conn[:buffer].bytesize >= CHUNK_SIZE * 4
              flush_to_backend(conn, request_id)
            end
          end
          temp.flush
          finalize_upload(conn, request_id, temp)
        rescue IOError, Errno::ECONNRESET => e
          handle_client_disconnect(request_id, e)
        end
      end

      setup_timeout(request_id, reader_thread, 30)
      reader_thread
    end

    private

    def register_callback(request_id, conn, temp)
      @callback_mutex.synchronize do
        @pending_callbacks[request_id] = {
          conn: conn,
          temp: temp,
          registered_at: Time.now,
          completed: false
        }
      end
    end

    def setup_timeout(request_id, thread, seconds)
      Thread.new do
        sleep(seconds)
        cb = @callback_mutex.synchronize { @pending_callbacks[request_id] }
        if cb && !cb[:completed]
          thread.kill rescue nil
          cleanup_callback(request_id)
        end
      end
    end

    def handle_client_disconnect(request_id, error)
      cb = @callback_mutex.synchronize { @pending_callbacks[request_id] }
      return unless cb

      # Capture disconnect info BEFORE releasing the connection
      disconnect_message = "DISCONNECT #{request_id} #{error.class}\n"

      cb[:temp].close
      cb[:temp].unlink rescue nil

      # Notify backend using the connection before returning it to pool
      notify_backend_disconnect(cb[:conn], request_id, disconnect_message)

      # Only checkin AFTER all usage is complete
      @pool.checkin(cb[:conn])

      @callback_mutex.synchronize do
        cb[:completed] = true
      end
    end

    def notify_backend_disconnect(conn, request_id, message)
      # Connection is still checked out - safe to use its buffer
      conn[:buffer].replace(message)
      flush_to_backend(conn, request_id)
    end

    def cleanup_callback(request_id)
      cb = @callback_mutex.synchronize { @pending_callbacks.delete(request_id) }
      return unless cb
      @pool.checkin(cb[:conn])
      cb[:temp].close rescue nil
      cb[:temp].unlink rescue nil
    end

    def flush_to_backend(conn, request_id)
      begin
        conn[:socket] ||= TCPSocket.new(@backend_host, @backend_port)
        conn[:socket].write(conn[:buffer])
        conn[:buffer].clear
      rescue Errno::ECONNREFUSED, Errno::EPIPE => e
        conn[:socket]&.close rescue nil
        conn[:socket] = nil
        raise e
      end
    end

    def finalize_upload(conn, request_id, temp)
      flush_to_backend(conn, request_id) unless conn[:buffer].empty?
      conn[:socket]&.write("COMPLETE #{request_id} #{temp.size}\n")
      @pool.checkin(conn)
      temp.close
      temp.unlink rescue nil
      @callback_mutex.synchronize do
        cb = @pending_callbacks.delete(request_id)
        cb[:completed] = true if cb
      end
    end

    def error_response(socket, code)
      socket.write("HTTP/1.1 #{code}\r\n\r\n")
    end
  end

  class Server
    def initialize(port: 8080, backend_host: '127.0.0.1', backend_port: 9090)
      @port = port
      @pool = ConnectionPool.new(max_size: 10)
      @handler = UploadHandler.new(@pool, backend_host, backend_port)
    end

    def start
      server = TCPServer.new('0.0.0.0', @port)
      loop do
        client = server.accept
        Thread.new(client) { |c| process_request(c) }
      end
    end

    private

    def process_request(client)
      headers = read_headers(client)
      return unless headers

      content_length = extract_content_length(headers)
      request_id = SecureRandom.hex(16)

      if content_length && content_length > 0
        @handler.handle_upload(client, content_length, request_id)
      else
        client.write("HTTP/1.1 400\r\n\r\n")
        client.close
      end
    rescue => e
      client&.close rescue nil
    end

    def read_headers(client)
      headers = ""
      while (line = client.gets)
        break if line.strip.empty?
        headers << line
      end
      headers.empty? ? nil : headers
    end

    def extract_content_length(headers)
      if headers =~ /Content-Length:\s*(\d+)/i
        $1.to_i
      end
    end
  end
end
